W.note: A vivid polar nacreous cloud, true to its dry, post-sunset formation, whose closing question about who is watching lands on the poem's own solitude.

X.note: A rhymed catalogue of cloud names with stock phrasing and a moralizing question tacked on at the end, with no real turn.

Y.note: Accurately names lenticular and nacreous clouds, but generic diction like winter's hush and a muddled final question ('fails to name it') weaken it.

Z.note: Iridescent polar cloud observed as the sun climbs, with the colour leaving the rim first, so the closing question 'Which band went out last?' grows directly out of the observation.
